in year 1855, Missouri law house have test of Celia. Celia be woman, not free. Celia kill her owner, Robert.

12 white man judge say Celia must die. high law house say no. Celia die on day 21 of month 12, year 1855.

about year 1819, Robert leave Virginia land. Robert go west. after time, Robert live in Missouri with married woman and child. by year 1850, Robert be rich man. he be owner of 800 field, big farm and 5 male man who work for him.

Robert married woman die in year 1849. in year 1850, Robert go to other town and get Celia, first female who work for him. it be may Robert do bad thing to 14 year old Celia first time on road back to Missouri.

back on Robert land, Celia get small house for her, 50 foot from big house. she live far from male man of Robert. between 1850 and 1855, Robert do bad thing to Celia many time. Celia have two child in 5 year. one of child have Robert for father.

before year 1855, Celia love one of other male man on Robert land. in year 1855, Celia have child in body for three time. child may be from that man or Robert. that man say, no more with her if she not leave old man.

Celia attempt to say please to Robert family and Robert self. on or near day 23 of month 6, year 1855, Celia say please to Robert, leave her by self, she be sick and have child in body. Robert say no. he say he come to her house that night.

Celia say she will make pain him if he attempt bad thing again. after talk, Celia go and find big stick, put it by wall in her house.

on night of day 23 of month 6, year 1855, after rest of family go to bed, Robert come to Celia house, like he say he do. Celia attempt to say no to bad want of him, and when he not stop, she hit him on head with big stick she bring in house that day. after she hit him first time, he put out arm like he want take her. she hit him second time, which kill him. she then put Robert body in fire place. she burn it all night. she crush some small bone with rock, and put bone too big to crush under floor by fire.

after morning, Celia get help of 12 year old boy, son of son of Robert, to throw dust of Robert body. boy say Celia tell him she give him 24 nut if he carry dust out.

on morning of day 24 of month 6, year 1855, two daughter of Robert fear when he not come to meal. they look all over land for him. they get help of near man when look not work. William, owner of near farm, and two son of Robert join look. William say to that man, where Robert be? he say it not good to look far, only near round house. then that man say last walk of Robert be on road from big house to Celia house.

after look in Celia house find no thing, William question Celia, who not go far after she kill owner. she go on with normal work. Celia first say she know no thing of Robert. but William keep question her and use make pain word and fear to get her talk. at last, Celia tell she kill Robert and attempt to burn body, but she say she not want kill him when she hit him, only want make pain him.

after Celia tell, family get bone of Robert body and put in box.

after day, day 25 of month 6, year 1855, one son of Robert give paper, and judge give order. six man group of judge go to Robert land to hear William, boy and Celia. after hear, group say there be cause to take Celia to prison for kill of Robert. Celia go to prison, waiting for test in month 10. in prison, one man question Celia more question to know if she do it by self. Celia say again and again she have no help to kill Robert or burn body.

on day 16 of month 8, year 1855, judge group say Celia must go to test. same day, William, judge, take help man for Celia. John lead them.

on day 9 of month 10, year 1855, Celia be bring to law house in Missouri to be test by 12 white man. she say not do it. test start.

first man call by law be army chief. he talk with Celia in her room after law take her. he tell about talk with Celia. Celia say old man have sex with her. on night of kill, Celia say do not come, if he come she make him bad. then army chief tell how Celia kill old man and put old man body in fire dust.

Celia help man question army chief many time. they talk about sex between old man and Celia. Celia say second child be of old man. they also say old man make her do sex on road from other land. army chief say he can not say for true if old man make her do sex on that journey. but he say it be hear that he do. it seem not like he hear it from any other than Celia. help man also question army chief about Celia reason. army chief say Celia tell him she not want kill, only make old man bad. law man say no to that talk. judge say yes to law man, so answer go off record.

son of old man be after man call by law. he tell about look for father. after he join group look for old man, some bone be find short way from Celia house by walk. he and sister take bone, put in box, and leave box with man of law writing.

elder daughter of old man be after call by law. she hunt on all walk and every place for father before she learn where bone be put, at end of day 24 of month 6, year 1855. she tell about find bone in fire dust in and near house where Celia live. also one metal thing, one button and one knife. she say knife be of father.

in question from help man, she say Celia be sick. Celia take sick in month 2 and be sick always. this make clear help man want make people feel sad for Celia. help man also question about father sleep place, on night of kill. she give little answer and say she not see bed where father sleep.

young son of daughter of old man come to law place then. he say he be up in red berry tree early in morning when old man be not here. Celia give him 24 nut if he carry fire dust out of house. he say yes, and put dust by side of walk. after, he see group take bone up out of dust. help man question him about old man sleep place on night of kill, same as they question daughter of old man. he give help man little answer. he only say young brother of him, 4 year old, sleep in same room as old man that night.

after, law call near man of old man come here. he lead group look for old man. when law question him, he tell how and where group find old man bone. in question from help man, they question about talk with Celia on day 23 of month 6, year 1855. he say Celia kill old man only after he make her bad many time. he say good for her to tell. child will not go from her if she tell. he have rope make for her if she not tell. he also say Celia say she make old man bad if he not stop make her do sex while she be sick. she say she not want kill him, make him bad but not kill him.

last, law call Dr Smith and Dr young man come here. they look at bone from fire dust in and near Celia house. two Dr say bone be of big man body.

first man call by help man be Dr James Martin, man who make people well. help man want make people not know that Celia by self can kill old man and burn body in way law say. help man question Dr Martin. can body of big man be burn in common fire in house from hour 10 at night to hour 4 in morning? law man say no. judge say yes to law man, so help man stop. help man do two more time, say question again. law man say no every time, and judge say yes to law man every time. so help man stop this talk.

after, Celia side call Thomas to speak. Thomas be there when man give Celia question in hot month, after law take her.

Celia side want to know reason from Thomas, about why Celia hit man first and second time.

Thomas say Celia say she hit man first time, only to make him stop, to keep him from sex with her. after law man say no, that part go off record.

and she hit second time because he put hand up, she be afraid he take her.

with Thomas word, Celia side attempt to make group of many man think Celia act for self when she kill man.

Celia side and law man two can give judge man order for group of many man. judge man can take order or say no.

Celia side give judge man many order. all request group to free Celia if group think she act to stop sex force from owner when she kill man.

in Missouri, law say it be crime to take any woman by force, against her will, to make her do sex. and if woman kill man to stop that crime, law may call it good reason.

Celia side request judge man tell group that word any woman with woman under owner, and Celia no be wrong if she act to stop sex force when she kill man.

judge man not take order, so group never hear it. judge man give group other order. do not talk about reason for crime, do not let group free Celia for act to stop sex force from owner.

on day 10 of month 10, year 1855, group of many man say Celia kill man in first degree.

day after group make decision, Celia side request judge man to put off decision and make new test.

judge man say no. judge man say Celia be hanging by neck till dead on day 16 of month 11, year 1855.

Celia side then request high law place of Missouri to look again at it. high law place say yes to look again, but judge man not give stop order for death. so Celia can die before look be end.

on night of day 11 of month 11, year 1855, 5 day before her hanging day, man take Celia out of prison room.

she come back to prison room after first death day go past, and get new death day, day 21 of month 12.

after she come back, Celia side send letter to judge man of high law place. letter say Celia be take out by person, and they feel more than normal interest for girl Celia. they think she do act of kill man to stop sex force.

they also send record of Celia thing, want high law place look at it, and want stop order so Celia not die before high law place look.

high law place answer on day 14 of month 12, year 1855. they say after look at record of law place in that land, it be right to say no to request. so high law place give no stop order for Celia death.

Celia die by hanging on day 21 of month 12, year 1855, at half past 2 in day.

Celia test be at time when owner of people be big fight in America, and decision have important sense for law of people under owner, most of all black woman.

at that time, owner can do sex force on people, when law see people only as property, with few help or power of law.

law see Celia as person only when she be make pain.

one man say, as Missouri and Celia make see, people under owner can not give yes or no to sex, can not give fight back. still law say they do crime and give them punishment. law see them as person who can think and have will, only for crime.

Ming rule over Manchuria be time when Ming house rule all of Manchuria. this rule take north east part of China and far north Manchuria.

from year 1380, Ming take Manchuria after fall of north horse people house. in early year 1400, Ming rule come to it high top, when Ming make big army house in Manchuria.

when big army house break, Ming power get small in Manchuria. Ming then use idea of cut and rule for many north tribe. from year 1580, one north tribe chief, before servant of Ming, start take control of most of Manchuria. in year 1616 this chief make new king house. son of him make new house. this house win Ming and take China.

from late year 1300 to early year 1600, Ming house rule over Manchuria. Ming win over north tribe that fight back. Ming king make big army house in Manchuria. Ming watch be in land to keep peace with far people. Ming use many way to make north tribe under Ming. north tribe not help horse people or east land people.

most north tribe, but not free north tribe, be under Ming. near north tribe be rule by Ming. other north tribe take small friend place under Ming. north tribe not keep connection with China be call free north tribe.

horse people from north win all of Manchuria in year 1200. land be rule by king of horse people. after Ming win over old house in year 1368, Manchuria still be under old horse people.

one man, one time old house chief and army chief of old horse people, win rule over horse tribe in Manchuria. as he get strong in north east, Ming want to fight him first, before horse people attack. in year 1387 Ming send army to fight him. Ming win. he come under Ming. Ming take all of Manchuria.

early Ming king house not put much control on north tribe as old horse house do. Ming not tax them. Ming not make letter station in east and north, which help more control.

still, early Ming make watch in near land under first Ming king, and after watch in north Manchuria under Ming king who come after. but north tribe chief still take tax and make army for them. north tribe not become like China people. watch help keep old way of China with far land. north tribe sign that they be under Ming.

by end of first king time, big idea for north tribe take form. most north tribe in Manchuria, but not free north tribe, be in peace with China. still, good connection between Ming and near land in north east not make. watch system hold south Manchuria but not come in north Manchuria. rule for tax and trade still not clear.

Ming king who come after be head of idea for north tribe again. he want peace with north tribe and stop them help horse people or east land people. this help make trouble at China edge.

one way to win north tribe be start regular trade and tax with them. this good for north east near land and Ming. Ming want some north tribe thing.

last, king tell near land from far north tribe land. near land be part of normal rule of Ming, with big army house and equal army and tax work as other land in China.

in north Manchuria, king who come after make many watch and end east land power over north tribe. he make peace in north tribe land near four big river. China king know good about all north tribe and chief.

China way and god, such as China new year, come to north tribe. China art, iron pot, silk, cotton and farm way go out to far north people. big snake picture also go out to them.

but watch do not always say king have power. some time watch help talk with far people.

in 1409, Ming king make army house on side of big river. Ming king send one old man, of far people, to river mouth. old man work be make peace with far people.

far chief be good to him. he give them present. they say yes to army house. they also send present man back to king house with him.

in 1413, Ming king send old man to army house again. he see far chief. he build god house, to teach god way to people who not live in one place.

army house have god house for one good god. old man make it in 1413.

some man say old man go to north island in sea. he give Ming name to one island chief. he know far people way and think well, so work be good.

present and trade come from army house to China. far chief take Ming name. god way go among old people. trade and talk move simple through station in army house.

but Ming king not rule far people power. Ming only keep small place in far north east of Manchuria. after Ming king die, this get hard.

law book say Ming make 384 watch and 24 army group in Manchuria. but this be only name, not true power.

some book say Chinese army house live at one town on side of big river, about 20 year, in old Ming time. this old Ming town be on other side of river from new town.

old man last ship group have 50 big ship and 2000 man. they bring new chief from big Chinese town to army house. this new chief live there before.

island woman of north island live with Chinese Ming office man. this come when Ming take present from north island and river land.

three old station of old Chinese king take present from island people. this start after war between them end in 1308.

in year 1400 to 1499, Ming station on north island and river land get animal skin present from island people and other people. this come after god house and army house make by Ming king in 1409.

Ming also keep one station there. in 1431, Ming get animal skin present from help chief of north island.

in 1437, Ming get present from four island chief.

island chief work give from father to son. son go with father to station.

sea land have Ming way to rule island people. iron thing come from big land of Asia through this trade. other people join in from 1456 to 1487.

island chief get Ming office, join with island way. Ming way on island be copy by Chinese king after.

army house end in 1435, 11 year after Ming king die. but watch live in Manchuria. Ming king stop true work there. chief of people act as office man. many far village and watch become half family tribe or small chief land.

after that, east land army of other land rule watch and Manchuria.

Ming and far people still send present and talk. but fight grow more. Ming army go round and stop many fight against king in Manchuria.

big fight be two plough attack on Manchuria by Ming king, in 1467 and 1479. also in 1583, Ming stop one far chief. east land army chief by wrong kill father of this chief and father of him.

late Ming time, Ming power in Manchuria get small. but Ming still give name to far chief. strange, but far people in this land cause fall of Ming king.

Sebastes be one kind of sea fish, part of rock fish family. it live in east Pacific.

two fish man of America give Sebastes first name in year 1890. first place of find be off California, near deep water. some man put this fish in small family. name say look like other sea fish. man not know this fish from other fish.

Sebastes have long, thin, smooth body. body deep be about 1 of 3 part of long. head middle size, have no sharp bone. mouth small, at front end. tail wing be flat at end. back wing have 12 or 13 sharp bone and 15 to 17 soft bone. under wing have 3 sharp bone and 8 to 10 soft bone. this fish grow long and heavy. colour be dark green brown or brown on top. under part be light green brown, brown or grey. green or white mark only under back wing. wing be dark green with yellow.

Sebastes live from south of north west land down to far south of California. it go down deep, but many time live in top water. baby fish swim in sea. in one year they live near sea plant, oil machine and other thing in top water. as they grow up, they move to live over high rock, and in middle water near oil machine. in top water this fish can be in all water near sea plant place. they also rest on floor of sea.

male become ready for seed at about 4 year old, at small size. female be ready after, at big size. this fish give live baby. egg live in mother body. male put seed in female body. mother may have 30,000 to 490,000 egg, more if big. they join in fall, and mother give baby fish every year from month 12 to month 3, most in month 1. baby fish swim in sea 3 to 6 month. they stop from month 4 to month 9, when big enough. fish live in mixed group with blue rock fish. small fish eat small sea animal. big fish hunt sea animal with many arm, and other fish.

this fish be small part of trade fish. man take it with net, hook and line. it be important for play fish man off land edge of south California, where many fish go down about 80 of 100 in past 40 year.

Fron Boeth and Pant Mawr be two stone cut place. they be near and join. they be on west side of big hill in north part of Wales. Pant Mawr work from about year 1850 to year 1879. in year 1886 part of it open again, join with Fron Boeth. two place stop in first big war. ready flat blue stone go by iron road to stone ship place by sea.

Pant Mawr be first of two place to start, about year 1850. it be on west slope of big hill. other stone cut place be on south east slope of same hill. they cut same blue stone line. blue stone cut place in this land cut line go down at angle. they cut big space in rock. two space on same level still separate by stone wall of not cut rock. wall be as thick as space be wide, to hold up rock over. to keep place safe, space under that level be in straight line. wall on one level be under wall over. top level of other place be high on hill. Pant Mawr be low, down hill. they make under land road to join other place, to keep all safe. number of level go on down from other place in Pant Mawr.

when first open, no iron road join low land. stone go to iron road in far town by animal back. road go on low land, and other place use same road too. then in year 1850, place build small stone crush place. they build slope road to carry rock to it. in year 1863 big step come. second slope road build to join crush place. road also build to join other iron road, be build by one man. road go on rock cut shelf, and some go by old road. then road go down by two slope road. make it most high two slope road in stone cut industry of Britain.

in year 1878 stone crush place get steam engine. about 100 man work in stone cut place then. but work stop in year 1879. place be quiet till year 1886, when join with Fron Boeth. some space work after. four man still work two or three space in year 1905.

Fron Boeth be big work, start in year 1886, to make Pant Mawr work go more. start at new crush place at low level. it never very good, but about 50 man work there at first. in early year 1900 make small amount stone. iron road from top of first slope road to Pant Mawr go round north in snake form to get foot of second slope road. this road stop. first slope road go up more, through round house, to shelf little more high on hill. it go by this shelf to south west, then turn at right angle to go in hole in hill. through high line between two low land. this hole be long. it be only big hole make for iron road, not for mine, in north Wales. many big waste stone still near far end of hole. this stone be hard grey stone, because building of stone cut place be make of this grey stone, not blue stone. iron road turn back on self to get second slope road. from top of this slope, more iron road go same way as road to Pant Mawr, but at low level. iron road to Pant Mawr have bridge rail, but road to Fron Boeth use common rail, flat rail.

chief crush place be steam power. over it, one table slope road go to many space make under first Pant Mawr work. level number go down, same as other place and Pant Mawr. crush place be on level 18. building be big. it hold three or more cut table, and three dress machine, and space for some more. by crush place be big steam pot, to keep water. second crush place build near end of hole in year 1890, call level 22. it may help low level, as place go down hill, or it may work stone from other stone cut place. this be two open flat shelf, use about 20 man from year 1877 to year 1883. then it join Fron Boeth, and shelf be level 19 and 20 in Fron Boeth number.

like many big work, true fact be not always same. book of iron road have word on Pant Mawr from year 1877 to year 1892. other word on Fron Boeth start in year 1886. one man say Pant Mawr be quiet by year 1916, and iron road take up by year 1920. but big map from year 1900 see no rail. work at Fron Boeth stop in first big war, but rail still on road for many year.

many of Pant Mawr hole be still open, and slope from them to work building be still in good condition. much of work place be still all, and rail road to top of slope still live.

there be stone line road near one way table slope. this make see it may have be water balance.

there be under of high office building part way on rail road.

Filipino land be many island, so water be all round it, make sea food one big food of Filipino people.

there also be great many land animal, such as water cow and pig, that people eat because of land.

plant and grow of food also be possible, because earth here be rich and hot.

in Filipino land, even though heat change be small, it still make big change.

this with change in plant and tree kind, and change in some thing of wood.

plant that like hot grow in low place, and plant from cold place grow high on mountain, such as hill town.

in Filipino land, water also change what food plant people make, for example rice or grain.

hot earth also be change by change in water.

five food plant make base for farm way in Filipino land.

this with rice, grain, big root, sweet potato, sweet fruit and big nut.

rice and sweet fruit be almost always on farm land, and farm put together have one or two of this.

as big food, 3 food plant rule. rice, grain, and root.

other food plant be help, small food or for some time of year.

rice be old big food of Filipino people, eat by about 3 of 4 people.

it be first food plant on most Filipino farm, and grow on more farm than any other food plant, because rice have few need of earth and air.

hot and cold be right in all place but high mountain land.

in other place, man make water go to rice, or rice grow in rain time.

because of good land, middle part of north island make most rice, and south land have most rice left over.

grain come first to middle island group in year 1500, and then go to other place.

because it be simple and cheap, grain take place of rice as food, and grow more and more.

many kind of grain grow, but hard grain be most common, because it healthy good to make grain rice.

though grain be plant much, it have many sick and bad small animal in Filipino land.

grain be big food in south part of south island, north part of north island, and island of middle group.

probable old group of food root in Filipino land, with big root, small root, sweet potato and white root.

though rice have take place of big root and small root as good food, root still be big food in some place, and help in other place.

when Spanish people come, they bring sweet potato, white root and nut to land.

sweet potato, also call by other name, take place of big root in place that still eat it as big food.

white root, also call by other name, become help food, on other hand.

nut also become help food, and go to many place, but few people grow it.

this root have be big food for poor people, and for hard time.

sweet potato, big root and white root grow well in hill land of one middle island, and in south land of north island.

green plant not become want like first three, because old people move land and plant. they also take plant from forest to help food. food garden most have long green plant and small green plant. old Filipino cook not use many taste plant, but this may be open talk. but trade with near land, like India, may bring some taste plant to Filipino food. most of all in south island, taste plant may lose when Spanish come. many of this work bring by Spanish, Chinese or Americans. some most want green plant be round black plant. also root plant, big green plant, small green seed, bitter plant and long green plant. but old stone sign tell white plate with burn green plant. this may be sign many green plant in old Filipino food.

this group have plant that grow in forest. some plant come from far land many time. fruit and nut not big part of food. they be more like help food. but tree nut be trade plant, because it have many use. still it only help food, like other plant in this group. some most want fruit be long yellow fruit, big fruit, orange fruit and sweet fruit.

near thing to old drink of Filipino land be tree nut drink. this drink make from tree nut milk. take milk from green tree nut and old tree nut. let tree nut water little change. then put some colour from sea tree skin. but this must make every day and drink fast. this drink also make from water of one tree, or from water of other tree. black drink and brown seed also bring by Spanish. two plant go wide. land be good for them. but plant not get big as strong trade plant.

fowl and fish be big meat in Filipino land. pig, fowl and big cow be big for rice work. also many Filipino eat them. but this land be in big sea, where most fish live. land have over 21,000 kind of fish, know to live in water of it.

pig, fowl, goat, deer, big cow and other animal be food of many. also water bird live here, because same bird live in near land of Asia. so Filipino land have them too. after, far people come and take over land. they bring new food. Spanish put sheep meat to old food of rice, fish, pig meat, fowl and cow meat. American also make it more strong. so more people eat sheep meat more and more. egg also become small part of food. one good food be bird egg, almost ready to be bird. cook it in boiling water in hard skin of it.

old and simple Filipino food be rice and fish. fish and fish food give most body power to Filipino. fish come every day for more than half of Filipino people.

land be round by water. so almost every family fish, many time or some time.

some common sea fish be small fish. many of them live in south sea and north water. people dry or salt them. other small fish live in south sea and middle sea. people dry or salt them. one more fish live over sea rock in south sea or north water. people make dry fish food from it. small sea animal and sea animal with many leg also many near land by sea.

because of land form, old fish must keep from go bad fast. people dry, salt or smoke fish. when dry, big fish make dry fish food. small fish make other dry food. salt fish be good in far place, far from big market. fish come only some time of year. smoke fish make by salt water, cook and smoke. people do this near big sea place and some other place by it.

rice be big food for this mountain people. but in dry time, from month 2 to month 3, when rain be little, they eat sweet potato and grain, like rice. they also take fish, slow small animal and small sea animal for food or for money. in old day, mountain many man take plant smoke and match when hunt for free animal deer and free animal pig. in forest, they also take thin plant, fruit for food, honey and bee wax, and free animal plant for food or beautiful plant.

first people live in high hill land. good earth and good weather make them farm people. they have two kind of rice. first kind be red rice. this rice have long grain and good taste. it come in many form. one form be soft and sticky when cook. one form be also soft. one more form be bit rough in mouth when eat. this rice also make rice wine. second kind be white rice. it grow in low land and plant in rain time. first people also plant sweet root, sweet potato and potato. they eat many green plant. many small plant from forest grow too. many fruit grow in many place. they eat meat from pig, cow, goat and fowl. they also eat forest deer, forest pig and big long animal. last, they eat fish from few river in this land.

second people plant and eat this kind of rice in few place. like first people, they also plant sweet root, green plant and fruit tree. they eat forest pig, deer, bird, forest fowl and fish. pig from farm be not only for eat but also sign of rich. fowl from farm be eat when child come out or when sick. it be not part of regular meal.

simple meal of three people be rice. rice be chief eat. they eat it with green, fish or small animal, salt, and some time cook meat of farm animal like fowl and pig. when rice be low, they eat grain or root like sweet potato. new berry and other plant be small food. rice wine be must in most old way and big day. they make it at house from rice and sticky rice.

four people eat only two meal in one day. one in morning and one in late day. or one at day and one at night. many meal have rice, but rice be always little because few woman do work. so they trade to get what they need. meal also have green and root like sweet potato, and some time fish, forest pig or forest deer. dog, pig and fowl eat only in big day. they eat fowl egg little because they let come out. some time before or after meal, family drink bitter drink from plant grow at house while they be near fire. rice wine only drink in big day.

five people live where water be many, so two plant time be possible in rice field on hill. they plant three kind of rice. man also hunt forest pig, deer and forest fowl in forest. they take fish and small sea animal from river and lake near this land. they grow fruit tree in green place. they make wine from sweet grass.

north people work most in wet rice farm. some field get work two time in year, other only one time, because water be too much or no water at all. two kind of rice grow here. one kind plant in month 6 and month 7, take in month 11 and month 12. other kind plant in month 11 and month 12, take in month 6 and month 7. north people also grow sweet root. sweet root eat. first, dry sweet root. second, cut sweet root in thin bit, steam it or cook it with sugar. sweet root in thin bit can put to rice before cook, make rice sweet. long green plant and other green plant grow too. they also hunt and take small fish and long fish, which be special good eat when cook. they also take small sea animal to make thick soup from crush rice with small sea animal, salt. they put it in pot and keep it till old. this be common eat in every house, and they eat it when child come out.

south people also do wet rice farm, but chief work be hunt and find eat in forest. they find root, honey and fruit to get more eat. forest animal like deer, forest pig, small forest cat and long animal be salt and dry in sun to keep it. like north people, there be two kind of rice. red rice and white small grain rice. red rice get name from red. white small grain rice be white and small grain. common fish be long fish and small river fish. they also eat small sea animal and other water animal. pig, fowl, dog and cow be farm animal for more eat. dog meat be good eat, and pig and fowl use in old way, most time.

Mount Perry powder store be old place to keep powder. it be on sand road, north of other road. it be in north part of Australia. government work group build it in year 1874. on day 10 of month 6, year 2011, it go on list of important place.

stone powder store be in big field east of sand road. it be north of town of Mount Perry. man build it in year 1874 to keep fire power safe. fire power be use in red metal mine work at Mount Perry. it be most old government powder store in this land that still live.

early run in this place with place from year 1849, and Mount Perry in year 1851. red metal be find at Mount Perry in middle of year 1869. on day 2 of month 6, year 1871, government map man tell one man to make map for town. town be call Perry at first. after that, name change to old name. so new town be make on self land, half of one long distance from old name place. government letter and talk box have to move to new town. new town after that know as town of Mount Perry.

Mount Perry grow good for most of year 1870 to year 1879, when red metal price be high. mine work grow fast in general in this land too. in year 1872 first church build. town have 25 drink house, and letter start to send. by middle of year 1872, hot box make dirty metal, 80 part red metal, from poor rock. rich rock go out in rough way. by year 1873, about 3000 people live at Mount Perry. hot box open that year for clean red metal, so clean red metal can go on boat.

work to build powder store at Mount Perry start in month 9, year 1873. government work group call many man to tell price for build. by end of year 1873, wood and stone be put together. build start in two week. much money use to build in year 1874. one man get work to keep powder store at Mount Perry on day 13 of month 1, year 1875, with money for work. on day 22 of month 2, year 1875, word go out in government paper. powder store at Mount Perry be good place where powder can be keep. price to keep powder six week be one money. after that, two money more every week.

powder store be on road to old name place, now sand road, on land keep for powder store. word say so in government paper on day 18 of month 12, year 1875. west edge of this land be road. north edge be small water. south edge go with north edge of part 65, which be road to powder store. east edge be line from east edge of part 65.

for over 100 year, control of fire power and powder bring in to this land be work of harbour group. from year 1860 to year 1862, control be harbour group. from year 1862 to year 1893, harbour group again. from year 1894 to year 1928, sea group. from year 1929 to year 1963, harbour and sea group. in year 1964, control move to healthy group of this land.

under sea law of year 1876, chief of any boat come to harbour of this land with powder to put down, have to put powder in government store. many harbour group be in price of make powder store and keep fire power safe at harbour of this land. this law also tell how powder move and where powder keep in any place of this land, not only at harbour. in gold place, powder store first run by mine group, because control of powder store out of harbour not give to sea group till year 1907.

some common thing of powder store be. strong build, small window, solid door, air come through, hanging roof, wood floor with red metal nail or wood pin, not iron nail, and sky fire stick with red metal earth band.

powder store be most time far from other house, and some time have earth wall round to turn fire blow. many powder store group have wall or wood wall round, to keep people out.

government work group build powder store in year 1860 to year 1869 at three place. big town, town of wood and town of gold. in year 1870 to year 1879 they build at many place, and Mount Perry be one of them. first powder store in many place be build in year 1880 to year 1889. one be on boat, and eight more be on land. powder store at Mount Perry be first government powder store know to still live in this land.

use of powder store be near join to good work of mine in town. low red metal price think Mount Perry red metal mine shut in second half of year 1877. town stop grow, and only 500 people live here by year 1883. at this time red metal mine be work on small scale. man mine work mine for self, and give part money with owner. little heat box work too. owner of mine be still for iron road from south town to Mount Perry. iron road make cheap price to bring wood fire

in year 1877 land government say yes to three rail. every rail join mine town to big harbour. but when rail come to Mount Perry in year 1884, big growth not come. copper price still low.

mine shut by month 4, year 1885, but open again in year 1888 when price go up. Mount Perry have little come back. by month 10, year 1888, fire oven build again and hole open again by company of copper and gold.

after copper price fall in month 4, year 1889, mine shut again. in year 1891 writing say stop of copper work almost kill place. all people who can get work leave, or leave now.

powder store go back to land in year 1891, when mine fall and hard money all over land. also wood land north of small river go back. in year 1892 two land become part of farm 848, part 5, and part 194 after.

in ten year after store shut, all change. in year 1901 big company of copper come to work at Mount Perry. Mount Perry have big growth in early year 1900. people on field be about 2000 in year 1904, 25 Chinese among them.

in this time copper be big money for land. most big copper make come from north town, Mount Perry, and two more hill town.

from year 1900 to 1914, many heavy copper make at Mount Perry, and many heavy gold and silver. but last fall come before big war. mine shut for rest at end of year 1913, and in month 1, year 1914 copper company say it not open again. but some rock work go on under old money system. Mount Perry big good day be over.

after rock work fall, town lose many people, and many house fall or go far. many house take down or move. copper fire oven place now be old broken place. great thing leave be big stone hill. but powder store north of town be one of few old thing leave from big mine time of year 1870.
